# Khai Nguyen Air Compressor

> Professional industrial air compressor solutions, genuine OEM/replacement spare parts, and 24/7 emergency repair & maintenance services in Dong Nai, Binh Duong, and Ho Chi Minh City (HCMC), Vietnam.

## Core Capabilities

- **Genuine OEM Spare Parts**: Supply of high-quality oil filters, air filters, oil separators, cooling radiators, and compressor oil for top brands (Atlas Copco, Hitachi, Kobelco, Ingersoll Rand, etc.).
- **24/7 Technical Support & Emergency Repair**: Technical response within 2 to 4 hours in industrial zones of Southern Vietnam.
- **Energy Saving Solutions**: Designing and installing smart VFD inverter systems saving up to 30% electricity for factory compressor rooms.
